description: Measure streaming large-layer cold/cache reads and protected platform anchoring.
preconditions: Run performance scenarios serially with identical resources and size order.
assertions: 64/256/1024 MiB client reads match their digests with no additional upstream GETs on cache or Distribution hits.
Each platform anchors after releasing the controlled capacity blocker.

checks.description: Capture independent phase timings, payload metrics, task timelines, and performance logs.

outputs: Per-size timing, before/after metrics, task evidence, and backend logs.
